Req: As a user, I want the fruit cards to flip smoothly so the game feels responsive and fun.
As a user, I want a cheerful background and positive messages when I complete matches to stay motivated.
As a user, I want the fruits to appear realistic and colorful to make the game visually appealing.
As a user, I want the 'Play Again' option to clearly restart the game without needing to close and reopen.
As a user, I want the text and buttons to be large and readable so I can interact easily.
As a user, I want the interface to be simple, with few distractions, so I can focus on the matching task.
As a user, I want a calming background color and no flashing animations to avoid eye strain.
As a user, I want the game to show which cards I selected to focus my attention.
As a user, I want the game to load quickly so I can start playing right away.
As a user, I want the background pattern to stay consistent with the fruit theme.
As a user, I want visual consistency between the color selection screen and the game screen.
As a user, I want to play the game with only a mouse, without requiring a keyboard.
As a user, I want the game to work even if I make accidental double-clicks.
As a user, I want the game to explain the rules briefly before I start so I understand how to play.
The system shall display an introductory pane containing the Strawbeberya logo, title, and tagline emphasizing memory improvement and fun learning.
The system shall display a 'Pick Your Color Fruit Game' selection pane that shows fruit images representing different color categories
When a user selects a color option, the system shall transition to the corresponding color-themed matching game.
Each color game pane shall display a grid of cards representing pairs of fruit images to be matched.
The matching grid shall initialize with fruit images hidden until the user clicks on a card.
The system shall reveal the fruit image when the user clicks a card and checks for a match when two cards are open.
The system shall include visual indicators (e.g., border highlights) when a card is selected.
When a correct pair is matched, both cards shall remain visible. If incorrect, both shall flip back after a new card is clicked.
The system shall display a completion pane when all pairs are matched, congratulating the player and offering the option to play again or quit the game.
The completion pane shall include a "Play Again" button that restarts the game and and a "Quit" button, that exit Stawbeberya.
The game shall close gracefully, ensuring all graphics windows are properly terminated.
The system shall display fruit images with consistent sizing and spacing within the grid.
The grid background shall use a visually distinct color or pattern based on the fruit theme.
The program shall load and display fruit images efficiently to prevent lag when flipping cards.
The system shall display sufficient color contrast to ensure accessibility for users with mild visual impairment.
The system shall use simple mouse-click interactions for all major actions.
The application shall handle invalid clicks (e.g., clicking the same card twice) gracefully without crashing.
